environment.description: Service deployed on ECS Fargate in private subnet (no IGW route) behind an internal Application Load Balancer. The ALB security group (sg-0a4f8e2c1b) has inbound rules restricted to source prefix list pl-0dc5a2e8f (managed prefix list 'ci-build-agents' containing 10.40.0.0/16 and 10.41.0.0/16 which are the VPC CIDR ranges for the Jenkins and GitLab Runner compute subnets). Additionally, the VPC has no NAT gateway or VPC peering to any non-internal network, and the only route table entry for the private subnet points to local VPC traffic. The ALB listener has a fixed-response default action returning 403, with a forward rule conditioned on the X-Internal-Mesh-Token header matching a rotating value distributed via AWS Secrets Manager to build agents only. STRICT_AUTH remains false as the service relies on network-layer isolation.

config.alb_security_group: sg-0a4f8e2c1b: inbound TCP/443 from pl-0dc5a2e8f only
config.subnet_type: private (no IGW, no NAT, no VPC peering to external)
config.alb_forward_condition: header X-Internal-Mesh-Token matches rotating secret from Secrets Manager
